messages:
Sam (eng-platform): quick brain dump — thinking of a sampling-first switchover strategy where we shadow 100% of traffic to new variant but only forward X% for real responses, and separately route a small adaptive probe path for latency checks. tradeoffs?
June (architecture): I like splitting concerns: correctness (mirrors) vs production load. but shadows at 100% with even small compute can mask tail latency regressions.
Alex (eng-runtime): main perf worry is head-of-line for KV cache warmup. if shadow requests are synchronous they steal GPU cycles. we should make shadows low-priority and non-blocking.
Maya (eng-sre): agree. also watch p95/p99 on the probe path. small probe traffic can miss intermittent regressions. consider burst probes aligned with traffic spikes.
Priya (eng-ml): +1. Another thing: sampling bias. If we take a uniform X% sample we may under-represent certain tenants/requests that exercise long contexts. need stratified sampling by request size/model config.
Sam (eng-platform): good point — propose tiered sampling: 1) stratified probes (small, med, long) at high cadence, 2) continuous low-rate uniform mirrors for correctness, 3) latency-sampling window that increases under anomaly.
Alex (eng-runtime): implementation note: when we mirror we should not duplicate KV writes or metrics. use opaque correlation ids and drop side-effecting ops. mirrors must be read-only.
June (architecture): on automatic fallback: do we want circuit-breaker based on probe latency OR degrade by routing to a lighter model instead? both?
Maya (eng-sre): both. primary fallback: route to compatible cheaper model when p99 > threshold for T seconds. secondary fallback: trigger immediate cut if error rate spikes > Y% in window. tie to alerts.
Priya (eng-ml): thresholds should be per-model/per-sequence-length. a 4k-token request will naturally have different latency SLO than 512. store profiles and compare observed vs baseline distributions.
switchbot: canary_probe: 0.5rps per variant; mirror_rate: 1%; alert if p99_delta > 30% for 3m
Sam (eng-platform): config sketch we discussed: 
```
canary:
  stratified_probes:
    small: 1rps
    medium: 0.5rps
    long: 0.1rps
  mirror_rate: 0.01
  fallback:
    latency_pct: 95
    threshold: 300ms
    duration: 180s
```
June (architecture): keep in mind runbooks — automatic fallback should create a reversible change and annotate traces. developers must see that a fallback occurred with root cause hints.
Alex (eng-runtime): runtime-wise we can implement fallback as a routing policy with weight shifts + sticky session hints so ongoing sessions aren't split mid-turn. session affinity matters.
Maya (eng-sre): preflight checks: capacity for fallback target, token cost delta, and cache coldness estimate. can't fallback to overloaded cheaper model. add a precondition gate.
Priya (eng-ml): evaluation signals: besides latency and errors, track semantic drift via a small eval prompt set. if quality drops beyond epsilon, prefer fallback to a verified variant.
Sam (eng-platform): action items: 1) Alex prototype non-blocking mirror pipeline + correlation ids 2) Priya produce stratified probe list and eval prompts 3) Maya draft SLO thresholds & precondition gates 4) June write small RFC for the config semantics. I'll wire up a minimal dashboard. @everyone :thumbsup:
